h1: Polaroid-style filter for iPhone: the instant photo look
card_summary: Folding, square and mini instant film looks for photos you already took.
quick_answer: Instant film has soft contrast, glassy or tinted shadows and pastel highlights. In Halatto pick SX Fold (folding instant: deep blue shadows, lilac highlights), Square 600 (boxy instant: green shadows, pink highlights) or Mini Instant (credit-card prints: clear, bright, a little cool), then crop to a square or portrait and add light aging. Halatto is not affiliated with Polaroid or Fujifilm.
intro: "Polaroid filter" is how most people search for the instant-film look, whichever brand they mean. The white frame is half of it; the other half is the color of the chemistry.
Here are the three instant styles, what each looks like, and how to apply them to an iPhone photo.

sections.heading: Why instant photos look the way they do
paragraphs: Instant film develops in the print itself. The chemistry gives low contrast, colors that drift toward cyan, green or magenta, and soft, slightly glowing highlights. Older prints fade further and shift warm.
That is why a plain white border plus a normal filter rarely convinces: the color is what people recognize. Get the color from an instant look first, then add the frame.

steps.heading: Step by step: instant look in Halatto

items.name: Open the photo
items.text: Pick a portrait, a friend shot or a soft daylight scene.

items.name: Pick an instant look
items.text: Choose SX Fold, Square 600 or Mini Instant in the Looks strip.

items.name: Crop
items.text: Crop to a square for SX Fold or Square 600, or to a tall portrait for Mini Instant.

items.name: Age it a little
items.text: Open Aging and try Faded print with a little Sunlight for an older print.

items.name: Save or share
items.text: Save the photo or export a before-and-after video.

tips.heading: Tips
items: Instant film loves soft window light and overcast days.
Lower the look strength slightly on skin for a gentler pastel.
Keep the date stamp off; most instant cameras never printed one.

faq.question: Is there an official Polaroid filter?
faq.answer: Polaroid's own app is for its cameras and printers. Halatto offers instant-film styles and is not affiliated with Polaroid.

faq.question: Can I shoot with the instant look live?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the built-in camera in Halatto and pick Mini Instant or another instant look before you shoot.

faq.question: Does Halatto add a white instant frame?
faq.answer: Yes. The Frame tool puts the photo on an instant card with the wider bottom margin: Instant (square), Mini or Wide. Pick an instant look first so the color matches the card.
